title: Patch Attention Wisely: Understanding Patch Length in Attention-Based Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.08160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention-based time series forecasters commonly group consecutive observations into patches. Patch length is known to have a substantial impact on forecasting performance, yet its selection remains largely empirical. We develop a theoretical framework that explains why patch length matters for forecasting accuracy and provides a principled basis for its selection. For linear state-space models, we derive an exact factorization of the forecasting coefficient matrix that separates forecast dynamics from filtering dynamics. We show that dominance of a single forecast component at long horizons does not generally imply a rank-one representation. This explains why longer horizons alone need not reduce representational complexity. We combine the factorization with estimation bounds to develop a patch-selection criterion that balances representation and estimation errors under temporal dependence. translated_title: 明智的补丁注意力：理解基于注意力的预测中的补丁长度
translated_abstract: 基于注意力机制的时间序列预测模型通常将连续的观测值分组为补丁。补丁长度对预测性能有显著影响，但其选择在很大程度上仍依赖经验。我们开发了一个理论框架，解释了补丁长度为何对预测精度至关重要，并为其选择提供了有原则的依据。对于线性状态空间模型，我们推导出了预测系数矩阵的精确分解，将预测动态与滤波动态分离开来。我们证明，在长预测时域下单一预测分量占主导地位通常并不意味着秩一表示。这解释了为什么仅凭较长的预测时域并不一定会降低表示复杂度。我们将该分解与估计误差界相结合，开发了一种补丁选择准则，能够在时间相关性存在的情况下平衡表示误差与估计误差。我们的分析建立了在这些条件下……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个理论框架，解释了基于注意力的时间序列预测中补丁长度为何影响预测精度，并基于线性状态空间模型的精确分解，推导出在时间相关性下平衡表示误差与估计误差的补丁选择准则。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theoretical framework explaining why patch length matters in attention-based time series forecasting, and derives a patch-selection criterion from an exact factorization of linear state-space models that balances representation and estimation errors under temporal dependence.
